connector.name: Live Translate MCP by waxberry.dev
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for local speech translation (EN ↔ 中文) via Whisper + Claude + Piper
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package live-translate-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.waxberry. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
